BiblicalUsage: Jokneam is named 3 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Joshua 12:22; Joshua 19:11; Joshua 21:34. In Joshua 12:22, the record says, "The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;". It is named again in Joshua 21:34: "And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jokneam is named in the record, and I hold that God marks the ground his people walked.
